description: Source code for a network switch driver managing Realtek RTL83xx series switches within the Linux kernel's Distributed Switch Architecture (DSA). The file includes port configuration, VLAN, MAC address filtering, link settings, and hardware-specific operations for different RTL83xx families.

classes.name: rtl838x_switch_priv
classes.description: Private data structure maintaining per-switch configuration, port states, family info, VLAN info, and hardware access callbacks.

classes.name: rtl838x_vlan_info
classes.description: Structure describing VLAN configuration including tagged/untagged ports, profile, and forwarding ID.

classes.name: rtl838x_l2_entry
classes.description: Represents an L2 table entry with info on MAC address, VLAN, port, and static/dynamic type.

classes.name: rtl83xx_mib_desc
classes.description: Descriptor for MIB (Management Information Base) counters including name, offset, size.

classes.name: rtl838x_pcs
classes.description: Structure encapsulating physical layer (PHY) link management, including validate, get state, config, and restart functions.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_setup(struct dsa_switch * ds)
methods.description: Initial setup for RTL83xx switch, disables MAC polling, sets VLANs, initializes stats, and configures traps and PHY polling.

methods.name: rtl93xx_setup
methods.description: Setup routine for RTL93xx switches, configured similarly with adjustments for different family and specific hardware initialization.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_vlan_filtering(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,bool vlan_filtering,struct netlink_ext_ack * extack)
methods.description: Enables or disables VLAN filtering on a port with hardware register adjustments for ingress and egress filtering.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_vlan_add(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,const struct switchdev_obj_port_vlan * vlan,struct netlink_ext_ack * extack)
methods.description: Adds a VLAN and associates ports as tagged or untagged, updates hardware VLAN tables accordingly.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_vlan_del(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,const struct switchdev_obj_port_vlan * vlan)
methods.description: Removes a port from a VLAN, updating VLAN tables and resetting PVID if necessary.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_port_enable(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Enables a switch port, configures VLAN tagging, traffic, and port-specific settings.

methods.name: void rtl83xx_port_disable(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port)
methods.description: Disables a switch port, removing it from traffic and VLAN settings.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_port_bridge_join(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct dsa_bridge bridge,bool * tx_fwd_offload,struct netlink_ext_ack * extack)
methods.description: Handles port joining a bridge, updating port masks, and setting traffic accordingly.

methods.name: void rtl83xx_port_bridge_leave(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct dsa_bridge bridge)
methods.description: Handles port leaving a bridge, updating masks and traffic.

methods.name: bool rtl83xx_lag_can_offload(struct dsa_switch * ds,struct net_device * lag,struct netdev_lag_upper_info * info)
methods.description: Determines if a LAG (Link Aggregation Group) can be offloaded to hardware based on configuration.

methods.name: int dsa_phy_read(struct dsa_switch * ds,int phy_addr,int phy_reg)
methods.description: Reads PHY registers, supports special cases for internal PHYs and external PHYs.

methods.name: int dsa_phy_write(struct dsa_switch * ds,int phy_addr,int phy_reg,u16 val)
methods.description: Writes to PHY registers, supports special handling for internal PHYs.
